`id` is an auto-incrementing numeric string, and `name` and `capacity`
are required.  We may want to make them nullable.  The `floor` is optional
and may be a non-negative integer.  We may want to make it nullable, too.

`createdAt` is a DateTime, which is a plain ISO string.  It's not a
date-time object, it's a plain string that's ISO local — no timezone
arithmetic.  `UTC` is the default.  The `UTC` time zone is used by
`NextRequest.local().toUTC()`.  The `UTC` time zone is the default for
`DateTime` and `DateTimeLocal` types.

`title`, `organizer`, `start`, `end` are all plain strings.  We may want to
make them nullable.  The `title` is a non-empty string, the `organizer` is a
non-empty string.  The `start` and `end` are plain ISO local strings — no
timezone arithmetic.

is one-to-one.
